watch.summary: The streamer ironically claims he played better than his opponent in Rocket League despite losing 12-2, using absurd shot-conversion math and save stats as cope.

beats.what: Streamer breaks down his opponent's stats of 22 shots and 12 goals.
Streamer reveals his own stats of 3 shots and 2 goals, calling it a better ratio.
Streamer smugly declares himself 'quite the better player'.
He doubles down, criticizing the opponent's accuracy.
He highlights having 5 saves compared to the opponent's 1 save and laughs.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The streamer uses funny cope logic to argue he played better despite getting crushed 12 to 2. His confident presentation of flawed stats creates a classic ironic contrast.
